about.photoAlt: Carlos Gordillo, full stack and AI engineer, in Puerto Boyacá, Colombia
paragraphs: Full Stack and AI developer focused on building complete products: interfaces, APIs, data and deployment. I work with React, TypeScript, Node.js and Python, and integrate deep learning models — LSTM, Transformers and convolutional networks — to turn data into decisions.

I design and operate the infrastructure behind those products: Docker containers on self-managed Linux servers, PostgreSQL, ETL pipelines with n8n, and secure exposure through Cloudflare Tunnel and Zero Trust policies. I have processed over 50,000 records and shipped real-time monitoring dashboards.

I care about the intersection of product, data and artificial intelligence: models that are trained, served and explained. When I am not building, I explore new automation architectures and ways to make complex systems feel simple.

sobre.lead: Mechatronics engineer from Universidad de Pamplona and full stack and AI developer. I build complete products and operate the infrastructure behind them.
sobre.photoAlt: Carlos Gordillo, mechatronics engineer and full stack and AI developer
bio: I am a mechatronics engineer, graduated in April 2026 from Universidad de Pamplona. Mechatronics taught me to think in systems that sense, control and talk to each other; software let me carry that same logic into products anyone can open in a browser.

I started by automating processes that were done by hand. At Universidad de Pamplona I designed and shipped the institutional agreements system: a Node.js backend, a React and TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL, and n8n ETL pipelines that processed more than 50,000 records.

Today I teach programming at SENA and work as an independent consultant. I build with React, Node.js, Python and Docker, integrate deep learning models, and operate the whole stack: Linux servers, databases, automation and deployments.

work.title: Complete systems, not loose layers
work.text: I would rather deliver the whole product: interface, API, database and deployment. If something breaks in production, it is inside what I built and what I answer for.

work.title: Infrastructure is part of the product
work.text: Docker containers on self-managed Linux servers, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Tunnel and Zero Trust policies. I deploy and operate what I build instead of handing it off and disappearing.

work.title: Models have to be useful
work.text: I train LSTMs, Transformers and convolutional networks, but the work ends when the model runs inside an observable service, not when the chart looks good in a notebook.

items.desc: Technical instruction in programming and software development. Competency-based curriculum design, hands-on labs and active methodologies to build measurable skills.

Full Stack architecture and implementation on a self-managed Linux server with Docker: backend (Node.js/Express), frontend (React + TypeScript) and PostgreSQL. ETL pipeline design with n8n for massive spreadsheet ingestion — over 50,000 records — with transformation, validation and incremental loading. Secure exposure with Cloudflare Tunnel and Zero Trust policies.

Product development with Next.js, Node.js and Docker on a self-managed Linux VPS. Process automation with Python and n8n. Integration of machine learning models — financial time series with LSTM and Transformers, convolutional classification — and real-time monitoring dashboards.
